dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate; the trailing edge displays a deep concave spline fitting from the posterior insertion point to the sub-apex, with an increasing rate of curvature toward the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute classification; the highest morphological point terminates in a sharp, low-radius vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a steep angular incline approximately 60 degrees relative to the visible horizontal dorsal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Estimated 1.7:1 ratio of horizontal basal width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive network of linear, depigmented scars (consistent with odontocete rake marks) distributed across the lateral body wall and the anterior base of the dorsal fin; multiple irregular white patch lesions and superficial epidermal abrasions visible on the peduncle region.
